title: Moldova’s total dominance at Albena 2022
excerpt: The Republic of Moldova achieved total, unprecedented dominance at the “ALBENA 2022” International Table Tennis Festival (Bulgaria)
body_html:
We look back once more at the outstanding performance of Moldovan table tennis players at the international tournament in Bulgaria and celebrate the festival results, in the hope that such success will stay with our players in future international competitions.

As a reminder, the Republic of Moldova achieved total, unprecedented dominance at the “ALBENA 2022” International Table Tennis Festival (Bulgaria), held on 20-24 July.

At this large-scale tournament, with competitors from 12 countries (Bulgaria, Romania, Slovakia, Latvia, Lithuania, Israel, Hungary, Turkey and others), the Republic of Moldova was represented by 12 professional players.

At the tournament, Moldovan players won 6 gold, 3 silver and 4 bronze medals, as follows:

1st place (OPEN singles) Mul Stepan

1st place (doubles 30-50) Dubrovin Veniamin/Romanenco Igor

1st place (OPEN doubles) Ni Igor/Țerna Denis

1st place (singles 30-39) Ni Igor

1st place (singles 40-49) Policiuc Alexandru

1st place (singles 50+) Natalia Deeva

2nd place (singles 60-69) Semipeadnîi Vladimir

2nd place (singles 40-49) Romanenco Igor

2nd place (OPEN doubles) Dubrovin Veniamin/Mul Stepan

3rd place (OPEN singles) Dubrovin Veniamin

3rd place (OPEN singles) Denis Țerna

3rd place (singles 30-39) Veniamin Dubrovin

3rd place (singles 70+) Nebesnîi Mihail

These results came as a surprise not only to the Festival organisers but also to the other participants, who in the end acknowledged the substantial rise in the professional quality and skill of Moldovan table tennis players over the past year compared with previous years.

Thank you to our heroes for these outstanding results, and good luck going forward!
